stories.title: Bank of Japan to keep rates steady, may raise FY2027 inflation forecast
stories.summary: The Bank of Japan intends to modestly raise its fiscal year 2027 inflation outlook while leaving the policy rate unchanged at 1.25% for the late‑October meeting. Officials note inflation risks but say there is no immediate need for additional hikes, and recent data show price pressures are not accelerating sharply. The article lists several Indian stocks as trending, including SBI.
stories.why: Inflation data can shift expectations for central-bank interest rates, bond yields, borrowing costs and household purchasing power.

stories.title: Tenstorrent raises $1.5 billion, valuation climbs to $6.2 billion
stories.summary: Tenstorrent, an AI inference chip startup, announced a $1.5 billion financing round that values the company at $6.2 billion, more than double its late‑2024 valuation of $2.6 billion. The round was led by Trace Capital and Innovation X, with participation from Cadence Ventures, Eclipse, Fidelity, SanDisk and T. Rowe Price. CEO Jim Keller said the funding will be used to scale chips for open‑weight AI models and video generation after Galaxy servers demonstrated DeepSeek model capability.
stories.why: The capital enables Tenstorrent to expand production of chips targeting open‑weight AI workloads, strengthening its competitive position against Nvidia in the inference market.

stories.title: India‑NZ free trade agreement in force, over half of NZ exports to India tariff‑free
stories.summary: A free trade agreement between India and New Zealand has entered into force, removing tariffs on more than half of New Zealand’s exports to India. The tariff‑free access is expected to boost products such as sheep meat, wool and other local goods. At the same time, New Zealand is preparing its first trade and investment dialogue with Brazil, following upcoming elections, and is also seeking stronger ties with Canada.
stories.why: Trade developments can affect currencies, business costs, market access and the external balance of the economies involved.

stories.title: Marco Rubio in India to boost energy, trade and defence cooperation
stories.summary: US official Marco Rubio is in India to enhance cooperation in energy, trade and defence and to advance the India‑US Comprehensive Global Strategic Partnership. The visit follows a May trip that included meetings with Prime Minister Narendra Modi and External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar. Discussions aim at a bilateral trade deal that would address tariff issues and improve market access.
stories.why: The talks are intended to deepen economic engagement and could affect tariffs and market access between the two countries.

stories.title: Trump waives Russian sanctions, potentially easing India’s energy concerns
stories.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump announced a waiver of certain Russian sanctions, a move that could facilitate trade between the United States and India. India, a major importer of Russian oil that has seen volumes fall, may gain additional flexibility in negotiating tariffs and energy policy. Secretary of State Marco Rubio is in India for talks on cooperation related to the waiver.
stories.why: It could help India secure more favorable trade terms and stabilize its energy supplies.
